create_beta_schedule: create a linear or cosine beta schedule for diffusion timesteps using get_named_beta_schedule
build_gaussian_diffusion: build a GaussianDiffusion instance with betas, model_mean_type, model_var_type, and loss_type
sample_diffusion_model: sample from a diffusion model using p_sample_loop to generate a batch of outputs
sample_ddim_loop: generate samples using ddim_sample_loop for faster deterministic diffusion sampling with eta control
compute_training_losses: compute training losses for a diffusion model at a given timestep using training_losses
